intro: Measured on one machine (Windows 11, Intel 13900K, RTX 4090) against the author's own retail console package. Every row below is an outcome the project produces, not a plan.

stages.evidence: the executable image maps at its preferred base, imports resolve through shims, static TLS is redirected, heap and file system come from the host
26,616 SPIR-V modules indexed; the boot loads 27,890 translated entries with 0 pipeline failures

device, queues, fences, allocators, heaps, command lists, the queue slot shift, the fence value address, the list lifecycle, the clear/barrier conversions, the display surfaces (console slot 127), the derived-pipeline extension (console slot 55) and the title's page VAs rebased into one arena are measured and mapped; the largest unmodelled console entry point left is device slot 70 (13,568 calls per boot, a CBV-shaped publication refused by name)

4,096 requests / 256 MiB decompressed at 131-144 MiB/s with every status entry S_OK; the blocks are read by a title CPU deserializer and never named to the device in the measured window; packed and swizzled reads refuse rather than guess
the title boots and runs its own loop past 300 s with no exception
frames record, close and submit with 0 failed Close and 0 refused submissions; every recorded draw executes after the title's page VAs were rebased into the arena, with no TDR and no lost device
all 10,241 graphics records build into real pipelines (0 refusals) and 41,545 derived pipelines are created through the console slot-55 answer (0 failures)
17,674-27,935 draws execute per 150 s run with 0 refused submissions; the page pull keeps the GPU stand-ins holding the title's bytes (273 MiB per 300 s run)

presents into the title's own adopted window: the adoption boot has exactly one visible top-level window in the process and 8,625 present calls with 0 failed; the earlier 300 s run presents 33,275 frames with 0 failed

the slot-2 resource-layout record (0x1B40 bytes) is decoded and the linear layout is the default: 44 suggests / 24 computers, 2 records filled exactly, 65 copies / 34,044 B, alive with no exception, device loss or TDR; slot 10's tiling structures are decoded but it still refuses by name because the window creates no 64 KiB-tiled resource

a full configure+build of the tree is green (237 of 237 targets, a second run prints up to date) and the gate scripts stay PALMETTO_OK / TESTS_BUILT; three known test failures are documented with their unblocks (docs/testing.md)

the presented 4K image is the frame's own draw target and is proven writable (a control draw reads back its exact colour), but reads back uniformly black: the frame's record is clean (clear first, draw last, no copy or resolve), fixed-function stand-ins and culling are falsified, the title's vertex/geometry path produces no fragments even unculled, and the sampled 4K placed texture's own pages are never written (0 of 129,792 scanned bytes over 150 s; the import had nothing to copy). The fixed-function state record's 8 fields cannot be pinned by a behavioural probe (docs/frame_capture.md, docs/texture_source.md, docs/state_blob.md)

1 - the title's own window; the runtime's own window is not created when it can adopt

the sampled 4K placed texture's pages are never written (0 of 129,792 scanned bytes over 150 s)

frontier.stop: no stop - the title boots past 300 s, executes its draws and presents into its own window; the presented frame still reads back uniformly black
frontier.summary: the title boots past 300 s with no exception, executes its draws with 0 refused submissions and presents into the title's own adopted window; a full configure and build of the tree is green (237 of 237 targets). The presented 4K resource is the frame's own draw target and is proven writable, but the title's draw leaves it black: the frame's record is clean (clear first, draw last, no copy or resolve), the cull hypothesis and the fixed-function stand-ins are falsified, the title's vertex/geometry path produces no fragments even unculled, and the sampled 4K placed texture's pages are never written. The XG layout slot-2 record is decoded and the linear layout is the default, the streamed 256 MiB are consumed by a title CPU deserializer and never named to the device, and the fixed-function state's 8 fields cannot be pinned by behaviour.
